code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin, suggesting possible inflammation or infection. Basophilia is present. Liver enzymes (ALT, AST) and CK are low, but not clinically significant. INR is elevated with low PT, possibly due to anticoagulation or liver dysfunction. CRP is at the upper limit of normal. Overall, findings suggest hypoxemia with mild cytopenias and an inflammatory response; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
